files..devflow/project.yaml:
# Infra Scanner — project policy for the devflow development workflow (agent-stack packages/devflow).
#
# What this file is: the project's rules, read by devflow **from the canonical branch**
# (recovery/phase-5.3-b1) at the commit it evaluates. A pull request that edits this file, the
# hook or the lenses is proposing new rules; it is judged by the rules already on canonical.
#
# Where it comes from:
#   * 인프라 스캐너 개발 워크플로 — Project Profile v0.2, 설정표, 작업 템플릿 (Notion, 2026-09-24):
#     the three classification axes, the review order, trace and confirmation states, shared
#     generated artifacts, the default end point.
#   * .issue-orchestrator/OPERATING_POLICY.md v1.3 (this repository, c6bd082): agents never merge,
#     at most one automatic rework, Foundation's two human gates and its publication as a commit
#     pair, labels as control signals, the guard paths. Where the two disagree this repository's
#     operating policy wins: it is the one that is enforced here.
#
# Status: proposed with devflow's adoption. Values marked `PROPOSED` need the operator's
# confirmation when this file is merged; changing automation scope is an operator decision
# (OPERATING_POLICY.md, "이 문서의 지위").
schema: devflow/project@1
project: infra-scanner

hook:
  command: [python, .devflow/hooks/scanner_hook.py]
  files: [.devflow/hooks/scanner_hook.py, .devflow/lenses.yaml]

# Paths whose change is a change to these rules (in addition to this file and the hook files).
# A task's own trace (.devflow/tasks/) is data about that task, not a rule.
rule_paths:
  - ".devflow/project.yaml"
  - ".devflow/lenses.yaml"
  - ".devflow/hooks/*"
  - ".devflow/templates/*"
  - ".github/workflows/*"
  - ".issue-orchestrator/*"
  - ".issue-orchestrator/**"
  - ".prompts/*"
  - ".claude/*"
  - ".claude/**"
  - ".githooks/*"
  - "CLAUDE.md"

defaults:
  end_point: integration            # canonical 통합 후 최종 검증·적용 생성물 확인 (Profile §1)

# 작업 유형 · 변경 클래스 · 영향 표시 (Profile §3; 설정표 §1)
task_types: [feature, bug, refactor, dependency, docs, build]
change_classes: [ORDINARY, FOUNDATION, CRITERION_CORRECTION]
impact_flags: [item_changed, contract_changed, evaluator_changed, shared_plan_changed, builder_changed, criterion_changed]

# The official criteria and the contracts in force. Their blobs are part of every verdict's frame:
# when one of them changes on canonical, earlier reviews of semantic changes are stale.
#
# Which is which, as this repository states it (read at c6bd082):
#   criteria   what is 양호 / 취약 — "현행 진단 기준의 Source of Truth는 구현 시점의 최신 공식
#              기준서이다" (Spec §6). Not the Spec, and not any list derived from these files.
#   contracts  the Specification (requirements; it wins over the TD — Spec, end of document), the
#              Technical Design (how; subordinate to the Spec — TD §0), the ADRs (OPERATING_POLICY
#              names Spec / TD / ADR as product contract authority), and the registries TD §5.7 makes
#              the single source of truth for their kind.
# Each file is named, not its directory: a verdict is pinned to blobs. `devflow-policy` fails when
# docs/adr/ holds an ADR this list does not name.
#
# Known drift, left to a person (authority documents are not ordinary task work): TD §5.7 names
# items/definitions/**/*.yaml as the Framework Item source of truth, but that directory holds only
# EXAMPLE-FILE-001.yaml; the items are in items/kisa/ and items/efin/, which evaluator.py also loads.
# TD §5.7 still calls primitives.yaml "Phase 5.3-B 신설 예정"; the file exists.
authority:
  criteria:
    - id: kisa-2026
      role: criterion
      paths: ["docs/baselines/current/주요정보통신기반시설 기술적 취약점 분석·평가 방법 상세가이드.pdf"]
      version: "2026 (no revision number in the document; BASELINE_MANIFEST.md §2)"
    - id: efin-2026-1-2026-03
      role: criterion
      paths: ["docs/baselines/current/전자금융기반시설 보안 취약점 평가기준(제2026-1호)_2026-03개정.xlsx"]
      version: "제2026-1호, 2026-03 개정 (BASELINE_MANIFEST.md §1)"
  contracts:
    - id: spec
      role: contract
      paths: [docs/SPECIFICATION_v0.3.md]
    - id: td
      role: contract
      paths: [docs/TECHNICAL_DESIGN_v0.3.md, docs/TD_tail.md]
    - id: adr
      role: contract
      paths: [docs/adr/collection-plan-transitional-architecture.md, docs/adr/existing-primitive-semantic-parity.md]
    - id: registries                  # TD §5.7 — the single source of truth of each registry
      role: contract
      paths: [primitives.yaml, evidence_keys.yaml, evaluator/check_registry.py, evaluator/applicability_registry.py]
  # Not authority. Roles only — none of these is ranked above an observation by rule (Profile §2).
  #   the implementation matrix calls itself "계획용 보조 자료 … 공식 기준서 대조 전에는 구현 입력이나
  #   확정 Item 분류로 사용하면 안 된다" (guard-protected against edits — protection is not authority);
  #   _expected_items.yaml is a list extracted from the KISA PDF pp.8–11 (the loader skips `_` files);
  #   the raw extracts and the legacy corpus are exploration material (TD §0.1).
  auxiliary: ["docs/implementation/linux-item-implementation-matrix.md", "items/_expected_items.yaml",
              "items/_raw_excel/**", "items/_raw_efin_excel/**", "items/_raw_pdf/**", "corpus/**"]

# The scanner's own state names, as the code has them (evaluator/check_registry.py `on_not_found`
# enum; evaluator/evaluator.py collection statuses). A trace's expected results must use these —
# never a workflow's words. The CI job `devflow-policy` fails when the code's enum differs.
verdict_states: [PASS, FAIL, NA, REVIEW, MANUAL, UNKNOWN]
collection_states: [OK, NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED, COMMAND_ERROR, UNSUPPORTED, TIMEOUT, PARTIAL]

# Mirrors PROTECTED in .issue-orchestrator/authority-guard.sh (c6bd082). The CI job `devflow-policy`
# fails when the two differ, so this copy cannot drift silently.
paths:
  authority_documents: [CLAUDE.md, docs/SPECIFICATION_v0.3.md, docs/TECHNICAL_DESIGN_v0.3.md, docs/TD_tail.md,
                        docs/adr, docs/implementation/linux-item-implementation-matrix.md]
  frozen_registries: [primitives.yaml, evidence_keys.yaml]
  semantic_owners: [evaluator, collector]
  items: [items/kisa, items/efin, items/definitions, bindings]
  builder: [scripts/build_submission.py, run_submission_tests.sh, scripts/run_mutation_checks.py]
  shared_plan: [collection-plan.tsv, dist/collection-plan.tsv, dist/infra-collector.sh]
  criteria_sources: [docs/baselines]
  count_assertions: ["tests/test_u43_nis.py", "tests/test_u54_ftp.py", "tests/test_collection_plan_*.py"]

# Checks — the GitHub Actions job names in .github/workflows/devflow-ci.yml.
#   scanner-quick    both guards (fetched from the pinned remote) + validate_schema_contracts + unittest
#   scanner-publish  both guards + build_submission.py + no tracked file changed afterwards
#   plan-ops         the Plan's operation difference against canonical, recorded as an artifact
#   devflow-policy   .devflow paths mirror the authority guard
checks:
  always: [scanner-quick, devflow-policy]
  by_impact:
    item_changed: [scanner-publish, plan-ops]
    contract_changed: [scanner-publish, plan-ops]
    evaluator_changed: [scanner-publish, plan-ops]
    shared_plan_changed: [scanner-publish, plan-ops]
    builder_changed: [scanner-publish, plan-ops]
    criterion_changed: [scanner-publish, plan-ops]

post_merge:
  # on the commit that landed on canonical: the full gate again, and the built submission artifact
  checks: [scanner-quick, scanner-publish, devflow-policy]

# Labels on the issue that a person placed as control signals (OPERATING_POLICY "Labels"). devflow
# never writes labels; it reads these as holds.
hold_labels:
  "needs-human": NEEDS_DECISION
  "proposed-tech-lead": HOLD
  "blocked": HOLD
  "blocked-*": HOLD
  "blocked:*": HOLD
  "failed": HOLD
  "publish-failed": HOLD

approvers: [astro3141]              # PROPOSED — 공식 기준·범위 결정 담당 (설정표: 확인 필요)

human_gates:
  FOUNDATION:
    - {id: gate1, phase: prepare, binds: task}        # proposal and exact allowed scope
    - {id: gate2, phase: integrate, binds: head}      # exact Foundation commit A
  CRITERION_CORRECTION:
    - {id: criterion, phase: prepare, binds: task}    # a changed reading of an official criterion

# Foundation is published by a person as A+B (OPERATING_POLICY "Foundation Rebaseline Transaction");
# A alone cannot be pushed, so it never exists as a pull request.
flows:
  FOUNDATION: transaction
flow_defs:
  transaction:
    need: >-
      Foundation A is reviewed before push and published by a person as A+B
      (sh .issue-orchestrator/verify-rebaseline.sh preflight/postpublish). Then name A in the
      task block: transaction_commit: <A sha>
    owner: human operator
    resume_when: canonical contains A and the rebaseline record
    record_path: ".issue-orchestrator/rebaseline/{issue}-{commit}.yaml"

reviews:
  lens_files: [.devflow/lenses.yaml]
  # Foundation: an identity separate from the implementer. Profile §7 and 설정표 allow a person or
  # a separate review agent; OPERATING_POLICY allows an independent Reviewer session.
  independent_for: [FOUNDATION]
  independent_by: [model, human]
  max_file_bytes: 200000
  budget: {model_calls: 6}          # per task, across its runs

loop:
  max_rework: 1                     # OPERATING_POLICY "Rework": automatic rework at most once
  max_no_progress: 3                # 개발 범용 워크플로 §8

trace:
  path: ".devflow/tasks/{task}.yaml"

shared_artifacts:
  - id: collection-plan
    path: collection-plan.tsv
    lock: collection-plan           # OPERATING_POLICY "Merge": item PRs are serialized on the Plan
    dist: dist/collection-plan.tsv

integration:
  merge_by: human                   # OPERATING_POLICY "Merge": Agent는 merge하지 않는다
  merge_owner: human operator
  method: merge
files.collection-plan.tsv:
#!collection-plan	1	3
op-000000000001	config_kv	1	/etc/login.defs	key=PASS_MAX_DAYS
op-000000000002	file_metadata	1	/etc/hosts	-
op-000000000003	service_state	1	telnet	-
files.dist/collection-plan.tsv:
#!collection-plan	1	3
op-000000000001	config_kv	1	/etc/login.defs	key=PASS_MAX_DAYS
op-000000000002	file_metadata	1	/etc/hosts	-
op-000000000003	service_state	1	telnet	-

mappings:

3.title: U-54
3.body:
## 해결할 문제
U-54 unencrypted FTP.

```devflow
id: T-0054
type: feature
goal: implement KISA U-54 with the existing service_state primitive
change_class: ORDINARY
impacts: [item_changed]
items: [U-54]
pr: 7
implementer:
  identities: [impl-bot]
```
